svg.title: Beef cattle farmer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as beef cattle farmer, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A broad cattle face has outward horns, side ears and a clear lower muzzle above a feeding barrier. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
